==About me==

By the time I started this series at the age of 12, I was already a voracious reader. I snagged my father's copy of TEotW before he could even read it. When I finally finished it, only to realize that it was the first of a series, I immediately asked my parents for the rest. I had no idea they would bring me seven more books just as thick as the first. Waiting for the ninth installment to be released, I read and re-read those first eight books six times, cover to cover. And before each subsequent release, I would go back and re-read the entire series again, to refresh my memory. Since the completion of the story, I have read (or listened to the audiobook version) an additional 4 times, with the most recent read-through ending in November of 2020.

I might have a problem, but burn me if I care.
